That's a good question — let me clarify. Returns can only be processed on orders whose status is 'delivered'. Since we just submitted the return for the air purifier, order #W9502127 is now in 'return requested' status, which means I'm no longer able to process an additional return on that order.

Also, please note that a return (or exchange) can only be submitted once per order, so it's important to include all items you want to return in a single request.

Unfortunately, that means I wouldn't be able to add the vacuum cleaner to a return now. Is there anything else I can help you with?
